items.content: <article>Wells Fargo and Bank of America offer down payment grants up to $10,000, Citi and Bank of America up to $7,500 for closing costs, and Chase $2,500 or $5,000. Here is how they compare.</article>

items.content: <article>New Jersey's NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance Program gives eligible buyers up to $15,000 or $10,000, forgiven after five years. Here are the June 2026 limits and steps.</article>
